issue.name: TOPSIS 2-tuple - Greece simulation
issue.description: Greece questionnaire scenario: seven real criteria and five real Q9 rankings (Questionnaires 1, 2, 4, 5 and 6). Questionnaire 3 is excluded because its ranking is invalid. The four questionnaire site names are provisional, while the linguistic TOPSIS evaluations remain synthetic until the alternative-evaluation spreadsheet is available.

sourceNotes.criteriaAndRankings: REAL questionnaire data. expert_a..expert_e are development aliases mapped only to questionnaire numbers for reproducibility, not respondent identities.
sourceNotes.questionnaire3: Excluded: it does not contain a valid unique complete 1 through 7 criterion ordering.
sourceNotes.alternatives: Saint George, Plati, Kaminaki and Tzermiado are real candidate locations co-occurring in Questionnaire 5, but are a provisional scenario set rather than the missing final alternative-evaluation spreadsheet.
sourceNotes.alternativeEvaluations: SYNTHETIC. Replace when the authoritative alternative-evaluation spreadsheet is available.
sourceNotes.c1c2ExcelWarning: Keep questionnaire c1 and c2 as declared here. Before importing the separate alternative-evaluation Excel, explicitly normalize its reported C1/C2 swap.
sourceNotes.expressionDomain: SYNTHETIC simulation configuration. Q9 ranks 1 through 7 are ordinal importance ranks, not linguistic TOPSIS labels.
sourceNotes.criterionDirections: SYNTHETIC simulation assumptions required by the TOPSIS API; questionnaire data does not establish authoritative benefit/cost directions.
